note: Black Hills NF campground the CCC built beside 2.8-acre Dalton Lake, in ponderosa pine about 9 mi north of Nemo (FSR 26 Vanocker Canyon Rd, then gravel FSR 224 Dalton Lake Rd). Sites sit on a short loop south of the lake, set back through the pines. Stocked trout and fishing piers, a historic picnic shelter, and the Centennial Trail (motorized southbound) with OHV trails nearby. Concessionaire-run. --Claude
